modmenu.descriptionTranslation.idle_boos: This mod reduces resource usage when Minecraft is not active.
options.idle_boost.backgroundDelay.toolt: Sets how long Minecraft must be inactive before the frame rate and render distance limits are applied. At 0 seconds, the limits are applied immediately.
options.idle_boost.debugModeToggle.toolt: Enables additional console logging to help find or report bugs.
options.idle_boost.framerateLimit.toolti: Sets the maximum frame rate when Minecraft is not active.
Enables or disables the frame rate limit when Minecraft is not active.
options.idle_boost.modToggle.tooltip: Enables or disables the features of Idle Boost.
options.idle_boost.renderDistance.toolti: Sets the maximum render distance when Minecraft is not active.
Enables or disables the render distance limit when Minecraft is not active.
options.idle_boost.title: Idle Boost Options
